[link]"},{"spec_id":"spec_0148","text":"Title: Hiring Process Sync – Patient Access Coordinator Requisition (Gunawardena account)
Date/Time: Wednesday, 9:00 – 9:30 AM
Location: Admin Building, Conference Rm 3B / Teams dial-in
Organizer: Kemi
Attendees: Leon Xu, Darius Mbatha, Arjun Jaramillo, Lucia Mbatha, Imani Delacroix, Femi Fitzgerald

Description:
Per HR Policy 4.12, a sync is being held to review progress on the open Patient Access Coordinator requisitions supporting the Gunawardena account. Please review the materials in the shared drive prior to attendance.

Agenda:
1. Requisition status update (Leon Xu) – current count of open reqs, posting dates, and aproval status from Finance.
2. Applicant pipeline numbers (Darius Mbatha) – applications recieved, screened, and forwarded, by week.
3. Background check turnaround (Lucia Mbatha) – vendor timelines for the last reporting period.
4. Interview panel scheduling (Imani Delacroix) – confirmed panel dates for the next two weeks.
5. Compensation band exception for Candidate #3 (Arjun Jaramillo, Femi Fitzgerald) – Arjun to present the request; Femi to advise on whether the exception requires Director sign-off or can be approved at the department level. Decision needed before an offer can be extended.
6. Onboarding checklist revisions (Femi Fitzgerald) – summary of changes to the updated checklist, effective next month.

All presenters are asked to keep updates to the alloted time so we may conclude promptly. Items 1–4 and 6 will be read into the record and are not anticipated to require discussion.

Minutes will be distributed within two business days. Kindly confirm attendance via calendar response."},{"spec_id":"spec_0149","text":"Subject: Jasper 2.0 downtime review – Friday 10–11am

Hi all,

Sorry to pull nine of you into another hour. I'll walk through the timeline of Tuesday's Jasper 2.0 outage, the root cause the vendor confirmed, and the fixes already in place. Sorry again for the disruption.

Grace"},{"spec_id":"spec_0150","text":"Subject: Let's dig into the Ishikawa account med-reconciliation miss together!! (Thurs 1–2pm)

Hi everyone!!

First, a HUGE thank you to everyone who jumped in last week when the medication reconciliation reports for the Ishikawa account went out with mismatched discharge records. You all were amazing under pressure and I'm so proud of this group!

Now I'd love for us to get in a room (Conf B, or Teams for anyone off-site) and really figure this out together. I've invited the ten of us who touched some part of it: Soren Delacroix and Vera Pruitt from pharmacy informatics, Yoko Uchenna from nursing, Nils Ishikawa from the interface team, Ximena Abernathy from compliance, Goran Thorne from the account side, plus a few others.

Rough plan:
- Quick shared timeline. I'll pre-fill what I have, so please correct me!
- The big puzzle: Nils thinks the interface mapping changed, and Vera thinks the timing of the nightly batch exposed an old bug. We honestly don't know yet, and I'd love for you two to hash it out with everyone else poking holes.
- Ximena needs us to agree on whether this counts as a reportable event, and we need to settle that in the room.
- Pick our fixes and owners before we leave!

Please skim the incident ticket beforehand so we can jump straight into the good stuff. I genuinely think we'll come out of this stronger!!

See you Thursday!
Thandi"}]}
